授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
This subject follows a practice-based approach to academic publishing. Students will develop a complete draft article, present it for feedback, and participate in a structured peer-review process through group work.
The subject runs across two quarters (Fall and Winter), with 90-minute sessions over 16 weeks. Developing a publishable article is an iterative and time-consuming process, and the two-quarter structure provides sufficient time for drafting, feedback, revision, and refinement.
The subject is offered ONLINE only via Zoom and scheduled in after-hours time slots to enable remote and working postgraduate students to participate.
PhD students are particularly encouraged to use this subject to develop and advance their own publication projects. Students are welcome to participate in the subject each year, using the practice-based approach to systematically develop, revise, and finalise a publication.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 研究データを新しい知識に発展させ、研究論文や学会発表を通じて発信するためには、独自のスキルが必要である。本科目の目的は、国内外のデザイン関連学会とその活動、学術論文作成を通じて学術研究を発表する目的と意義を紹介することである。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Developing research data into new knowledge that can be shared through research articles and conference presentations requires unique skills. The objective of the subject is to introduce local/national and international design-related academic societies, their activities, the purpose and significance of publishing academic research through academic article preparation.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Academic Publishing, Dissemination and Presentation of Research, Practice-based Learning
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: The subject is taught and presented in English. Students may write in Japanese (or other languages). Translation tools such as DeepL will be used to support intercultural communication. Students often find the publication process daunting due to the technicalities involved in lengthy publication processes. However, students must publish during their postgraduate period, and by familiarising themselves with publication processes, quality research dissemination can be produced. Although supervisors and lecturers can offer subject-specific knowledge, this subject will focus on publication skills and abilities of the research process

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.レポート: The article writing exercise will serve as the report to be presented. This component will contribute 60% of the course mark.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.授業への貢献度: The class contribution, peer review and group work will contribute 20% of the course mark.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.その他: This subject will follow a practice-based approach. Students will produce a full draft chapter to be presented for feedback and undergo peer review through group work. The subject will be running for two periods (90 minutes x 16 weeks), as developing a draft chapter is an iterative and time-consuming process. In addition, the subject will be offered ONLINE in the Zoom platformin in after-hour slots to enable remote and working postgraduate students to participate.
